verdict.rationale: Runtime probes confirm a live, first-party remote MCP server at mcp.reclaim.ai. It is OAuth-gated per the MCP spec and publishes RFC 9728 discovery metadata with read/write/mcp scopes, so agents can plausibly use the scheduling account as a tool. However, no vendor documentation was found, and the probes stop at the auth handshake, so the exposed tools are unverified. Missing for 10: documentation of the MCP server, evidence of which tools it exposes (availability, bookings, scheduling-link/event types), and hands-on or independent confirmation of tool calls working end to end.
